mechanism: Isolates: shared-nothing heaps, message passing via ports. `Isolate.run` / `compute` for one-shot background work. Not Erlang: no preemptive process tree or OTP supervisors in the language.
why: Flutter UI isolate must stay free; heavy work needs another heap because there is no shared-memory thread model.
useWhen: JSON parse, image codecs, any CPU work that would jank frames.
price: No shared objects; copying costs; isolate startup is not free; debugging cross-isolate is harder.
